Comments (English): [ Series 6 Freestanding 60cm Dishwasher ] || ---------------- || Previously bought a Bosch Series 4 dishwasher which I absolutely loved, but then had to leave it behind when we sold our house and moved. At the moment though, after almost two weeks of use, I can truthfully say I am loving the ease of use with this particular model. Oh and lastly, I chose the Black/Inox colour to match other appliances in my kitchen, and it looks great.

Sentence (English): We liked the last one, so when it wore out we got another.
Comments (English): [ Our second Bosch dishwasher ] || ---------------- || We liked the last one, so when it wore out we got another. Tried to get the same features, but now, some years later, the current version takes much longer to do a normal wash with settings as close as possible to our favourite settings on the previous dishwasher. I assume it is to be energy-efficient and to save a little water. This simply doesn't cater for people with solar panels. We want to be able finish the wash while we have good sun on the roof panels, generating electricity. When the wash drags on for another hour and the sun has moved, we have to pay for the electricity we use (and to add insult to injury, at the peak tarrif, which we pay until 9pm). Bosch need to take this into consideration, as domestic solar power is becoming very common in Australia. Another consequence of the changes with the new model, is that the dishes finish up wetter and cooler so they rarely dry fully even with the door open. A backward step given we have heaps of free electricity in the middle of the day. I don't want to be forced to let timing the start of a dishwasher cycle reschedule our daily activities. (We also miss the more useful rear dish rack we had on the bottom basket. With our last Bosch, we were able to fold down either half of it and now it's all or nothing. A backwards step in user-friendly design.)

When you use the setting for fully drying the dishes, unless you have a dish that is upside down or the top of it has a large seam that could hold let's say 1/8" of water or more, your dishes and plastic will come out bone dry! Sometimes we use the utensil caddy to put lids that have straws or other odd items, or overflow utensils that do not fit on the top third rack, which is also wonderful for little lids or spatulas, etc.And finally, the fact that it has leak prevention technology, which will sense if water is moving when it is not supposed to, and it will then shut off the water, drain it, and then notify you, this could be a blessing, especially when you have expensive wood floors in your kitchen that you wish to not get flooded.Consumer reports rates this as among the highest rated dishwashers, and in my opinion, for very good reason. Get it – you will be glad, if it fits your needs.

Sentence (English): We purchased two of these dishwashers and I've been using them for about a month now.
Comments (English): [ This dishwasher is a winner! ] || ---------------- || We purchased two of these dishwashers and I've been using them for about a month now. I can stand next to the dishwasher and cannot hear anything. If I put my ear against it, I can hear something, but basically speaking, beyond whisper, quiet. When you use the setting for fully drying the dishes, unless you have a dish that is upside down or the top of it has a large seam that could hold let's say 1/8" of water or more, your dishes and plastic will come out bone dry! Sometimes we use the utensil caddy to put lids that have straws or other odd items, or overflow utensils that do not fit on the top third rack, which is also wonderful for little lids or spatulas, etc. And finally, the fact that it has leak prevention technology, which will sense if water is moving when it is not supposed to, and it will then shut off the water, drain it, and then notify you, this could be a blessing, especially when you have expensive wood floors in your kitchen that you wish to not get flooded. Consumer reports rates this as among the highest rated dishwashers, and in my opinion, for very good reason. Get it – you will be glad, if it fits your needs.

Sentence (English): I'm a diehard Whirlpool fan, but I need to rethink this after buying this dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Terribly disappointed ] || ---------------- || I'm a diehard Whirlpool fan, but I need to rethink this after buying this dishwasher. It is the cheapest, flimsiest appliance I have ever purchased. Sadly, it's almost impossible to see these appliances in the store, so you are buying a pig in a poke. The tub is plastic and there is not enough mass or insulation to deaden sound. It's much noisier than the old dishwasher. And wash times are ridiculously long. The normal cycle ran more than two hours and didn't clean well. The quick cycle is only quick by comparison. The exterior looks sleek and attractive, but you have to really pull to open it. An exterior bar is so much better. Finally, the rinse aid dispenser is a catastrophe. The instructions say to twist the cap 1/4 turn and lift off. Then fill and replace the cap and turn to “lock.” Maybe if you have a child do this, you'll be okay, because they have tiny fingers and don't use reading glasses. If you're over 50, good luck! I could not be more disappointed with this purchase.

Sentence (English): Although this machine was a little loud it generally did a good job cleaning our dishes almost every day since we bought the house that came with it.
Comments (English): [ Died Prematurely - Control Boards ] || ---------------- || Although this machine was a little loud it generally did a good job cleaning our dishes almost every day since we bought the house that came with it. Like many, many, many others - ours would beep on its own at odd hours. We thought was cute for a while until about a month ago it started to be totally unresponsive - requiring the breaker to be flipped on and off to power back on. Everything I've read indicates that this is because either the control or UI board is failing, and will eventually result in a totally dead machine if not replaced. However, I've also read many accounts of people who've replaced both boards only to have them fail again. Sentence (English): We are a two-person household.
Comments (English): We are a two-person household. We spent a lot of time deliberating before purchasing a dishwasher. They say that with dishwashers, bigger is better, but we ultimately bought the 6-person model. -Reasons for purchasing the 6-person model-. 1. We are a two-person household and don't cook meals at home very often. 2. I can't stand having dishes piled up in the sink; if I bought a large capacity model, the dish capacity would be too small, so I wouldn't be able to let them sit for a few days and would likely just end up washing them by hand. 3. I often saw reviews saying that loading and unloading dishes from the bottom of large capacity models is difficult. 4. Since we don't own a home, built-in installation is difficult. (Of course, a freestanding model is possible, but we chose the 6-person model for the reasons above.) -Review after use-. Even so, it is a bit of a hassle because it is small when we use a lot of pots or pans every now and then. However, since we bought the 6-person model, I actually find myself running it more often, so I am satisfied with it. Since we are a two-person household, we even removed one of the spoon holders. I think it's more versatile because the tray has a foldable plate rack. At first, I wasn't sure how to stack the dishes, but you get the hang of it as you go. It holds more than I expected. If I don't have many dishes, I sometimes put frying pans and pots in to run as well. -Installation Review-. I agonized over the direction of the dishwasher when I first installed it. I initially installed it as shown in the picture, and having the door open toward the sink is VERY convenient. If the orientation allows, place it like that! I have since added a water purifier and rotated the door 90 degrees to face forward, but since water drips more than expected after pre-washing, I purchased an additional diatomaceous earth bath mat to compensate. (Otherwise, you end up doing the even more hassle of wiping water off your feet every time you put dishes in the dishwasher.) While facing forward looks nice design-wise, since I bought this dishwasher for convenience, I definitely recommend installing it so the door opens toward the sink if space permits!

Sentence (English): -Reasons for purchasing the 6-person model-.
Comments (English): We are a two-person household. We spent a lot of time deliberating before purchasing a dishwasher. They say that with dishwashers, bigger is better, but we ultimately bought the 6-person model. -Reasons for purchasing the 6-person model-. 1. We are a two-person household and don't cook meals at home very often. 2. I can't stand having dishes piled up in the sink; if I bought a large capacity model, the dish capacity would be too small, so I wouldn't be able to let them sit for a few days and would likely just end up washing them by hand. 3. I often saw reviews saying that loading and unloading dishes from the bottom of large capacity models is difficult. 4. Since we don't own a home, built-in installation is difficult. (Of course, a freestanding model is possible, but we chose the 6-person model for the reasons above.) -Review after use-. Even so, it is a bit of a hassle because it is small when we use a lot of pots or pans every now and then. However, since we bought the 6-person model, I actually find myself running it more often, so I am satisfied with it. Since we are a two-person household, we even removed one of the spoon holders. I think it's more versatile because the tray has a foldable plate rack. At first, I wasn't sure how to stack the dishes, but you get the hang of it as you go. It holds more than I expected. If I don't have many dishes, I sometimes put frying pans and pots in to run as well. -Installation Review-. I agonized over the direction of the dishwasher when I first installed it. I initially installed it as shown in the picture, and having the door open toward the sink is VERY convenient. If the orientation allows, place it like that! I have since added a water purifier and rotated the door 90 degrees to face forward, but since water drips more than expected after pre-washing, I purchased an additional diatomaceous earth bath mat to compensate. (Otherwise, you end up doing the even more hassle of wiping water off your feet every time you put dishes in the dishwasher.) While facing forward looks nice design-wise, since I bought this dishwasher for convenience, I definitely recommend installing it so the door opens toward the sink if space permits!

Comments (English): We are a two-person household. We spent a lot of time deliberating before purchasing a dishwasher. They say that with dishwashers, bigger is better, but we ultimately bought the 6-person model. -Reasons for purchasing the 6-person model-. 1. We are a two-person household and don't cook meals at home very often. 2. I can't stand having dishes piled up in the sink; if I bought a large capacity model, the dish capacity would be too small, so I wouldn't be able to let them sit for a few days and would likely just end up washing them by hand. 3. I often saw reviews saying that loading and unloading dishes from the bottom of large capacity models is difficult. 4. Since we don't own a home, built-in installation is difficult. Sentence (English): -Review after use-.
Comments (English): We are a two-person household. We spent a lot of time deliberating before purchasing a dishwasher. They say that with dishwashers, bigger is better, but we ultimately bought the 6-person model. -Reasons for purchasing the 6-person model-. 1. We are a two-person household and don't cook meals at home very often. 2. I can't stand having dishes piled up in the sink; if I bought a large capacity model, the dish capacity would be too small, so I wouldn't be able to let them sit for a few days and would likely just end up washing them by hand. 3. I often saw reviews saying that loading and unloading dishes from the bottom of large capacity models is difficult. 4. Since we don't own a home, built-in installation is difficult. (Of course, a freestanding model is possible, but we chose the 6-person model for the reasons above.) -Review after use-. Even so, it is a bit of a hassle because it is small when we use a lot of pots or pans every now and then. However, since we bought the 6-person model, I actually find myself running it more often, so I am satisfied with it. Since we are a two-person household, we even removed one of the spoon holders. I think it's more versatile because the tray has a foldable plate rack. At first, I wasn't sure how to stack the dishes, but you get the hang of it as you go. It holds more than I expected. If I don't have many dishes, I sometimes put frying pans and pots in to run as well. -Installation Review-. I agonized over the direction of the dishwasher when I first installed it. I initially installed it as shown in the picture, and having the door open toward the sink is VERY convenient. If the orientation allows, place it like that! I have since added a water purifier and rotated the door 90 degrees to face forward, but since water drips more than expected after pre-washing, I purchased an additional diatomaceous earth bath mat to compensate. While facing forward looks nice design-wise, since I bought this dishwasher for convenience, I definitely recommend installing it so the door opens toward the sink if space permits!

Comments (English): We are a two-person household. We spent a lot of time deliberating before purchasing a dishwasher. They say that with dishwashers, bigger is better, but we ultimately bought the 6-person model. -Reasons for purchasing the 6-person model-. 1. We are a two-person household and don't cook meals at home very often. 2. I can't stand having dishes piled up in the sink; if I bought a large capacity model, the dish capacity would be too small, so I wouldn't be able to let them sit for a few days and would likely just end up washing them by hand. 3. I often saw reviews saying that loading and unloading dishes from the bottom of large capacity models is difficult. 4. Since we don't own a home, built-in installation is difficult. (Of course, a freestanding model is possible, but we chose the 6-person model for the reasons above.) -Review after use-. Even so, it is a bit of a hassle because it is small when we use a lot of pots or pans every now and then. However, since we bought the 6-person model, I actually find myself running it more often, so I am satisfied with it. Since we are a two-person household, we even removed one of the spoon holders. These two issues .ake the dishwasher infuriating to use. This dishwasher is WAY too expensive to have these basic design flaws.To be completely neutral and honest, even with these issues, the dishwasher does a tremendous job of cleaning dishes and especially drying them. However, these traits don't even come close to mitigating the negatives of the issues previously stated.

Sentence (English): Good dishwasher as far as washing and drying but the design or manufacturing has some serious flaws.
Comments (English): [ Horrible Design or QC ] || ---------------- || Good dishwasher as far as washing and drying but the design or manufacturing has some serious flaws. A major design issue are the dish / glass support wires. The ones on the large top shelf are too tall overall. Bowls, Tupperware, etc don't sit well, flipping over or are generally unstable, dangling on the supports /separators. Plates and large bowls placed on the bottom rack sit better but all bottom supports are still very tall. Half being shorter or foldable in both racks would be a simple and effective solution, like other dishwashers. Worse is the bottom rack. The transition of the rails that the rack wheels travel on, sits up at least a half inch on the door compared to inside the tub. So, when pulling out the rack, the wheels hit this transition causing the rack to stop. One has to lift yhe front of the entire tub up, evenly on both sides, especially hard when partially filled with dishes, etc. Due to this, the rack often goes off track, damaging dishes, etc. We have several a bunch of dishes & bowls due to this horrible design or shoddy manufacturing and QC. These two issues .ake the dishwasher infuriating to use. This dishwasher is WAY too expensive to have these basic design flaws. To be completely neutral and honest, even with these issues, the dishwasher does a tremendous job of cleaning dishes and especially drying them. However, these traits don't even come close to mitigating the negatives of the issues previously stated.

Sentence (English): This is my second dishwasher after Siemens, which lasted 14 years.
Comments (English): [ SMV8YCX03E dishwasher ] || ---------------- || This is my second dishwasher after Siemens, which lasted 14 years. I must admit that I was very surprised by two things about this model: the quality of drying and quiet operation. The dishwasher runs every 1-2 days, I mainly use the Eco mode. The dishes are dried very well, although the cutlery on the upper drawer needs to be slightly wiped dry (I did not turn on the ExtraDry mode). The dishwasher is really quiet, even without turning on the night mode. You can easily turn it on late in the evening, because the end of work signal is silent and the door opens automatically. There is no need to turn off the device after washing. The notification volume can be changed, including turning it off completely. However, the main selection criterion was the baskets for dishes, or more precisely, the possibility of folding all the elements. This is useful for pots with sharp edges, which, when pressed between the standing wires, may damage their coating (this was the case in the previous model). I do not regret the purchase and I hope it will serve me at least as long as the previous one.
Comments (Original): [ Zmywarka SMV8YCX03E ] || ---------------- || To moja druga zmywarka po Siemensie, który wytrzymał 14 lat. Muszę przyznać, że w tym modelu bardzo zaskoczyły mnie 2 rzeczy: jakość suszenia i cicha praca. Zmywarka chodzi co 1-2 dni, używam głównie trybu Eco. Naczynia są bardzo dobrze wysuszone, chociaż sztućce na górnej szufladzie trzeba lekko przetrzeć do sucha (nie włączałem trybu ExtraDry). Zmywarka jest naprawdę cicha, nawet bez włączania trybu nocnego. Spokojnie można ją włączać późnym wieczorem, bo sygnalizacja końca pracy jest cicha i drzwi automatycznie się uchylają. Nie ma potrzeby wyłączania urządzenia po zmywaniu. Głośność powiadomień można zmieniać, w tym wyłączyć całkowicie. Głównym kryterium wyboru były jednak kosze na naczynia, a dokładniej możliwość składania wszystkich elementów. Sentence (English): Being a user of Bosch dishwasher for over a decade, I was initially impressed with the new Bosch Serie 6 Freestanding Dishwasher SMS6HCB01A installed on 28/12/22.
Comments (English): [ Deceitful Bosch technicians ] || ---------------- || Being a user of Bosch dishwasher for over a decade, I was initially impressed with the new Bosch Serie 6 Freestanding Dishwasher SMS6HCB01A installed on 28/12/22. Similar to observations made by the other reviewers, I have noted that the dishwasher is so quiet even on an intensive wash cycle that I had to check several times to ensure it was still running. Approximately 15 months later, I noticed the dishwasher was emitting a loud grinding noise and took a few videos before I arranged for a technician to attend. On 22/3, a Bosch technician attended and dismissed the issue, claiming that it was a 'normal' working noise, despite the dishwasher being recorded at a noise level of >55dB, which was much higher than the advertised '44dB' when working. I was also reprimanded for 'not loading the dishes properly'. I was questioned why I did not purchase a Series 8 dishwasher if I was so concerned about the noise level. Suggesting that my expectations for noise levels are unrealistic is insulting and fails to address the fundamental issue at hand. Nevertheless, I told him that I wanted a black dishwasher to match my renovation and this was the only Bosch model that was available in black at the time of purchase. After the technician left, I went onto Bosch's website and followed the troubleshooting instructions listed under 'grinding noise'. This includes cleaning to ensure the pump impeller is free from debris and food particles. As the loud grinding noise persisted after rigorous cleaning, I arranged for another technician as research revealed that it could be mechanical if blockage is excluded. The second technician attended 23/4 and again dismissed any abnormal operating noise. When I provided a video of the noise level averaging 54dB on an empty load vs. the advertised working noise of 44dB, he immediately attributed it to food blockage. I explained the dishwasher had been cleaned and free of food and debris, and urged him to do a confirmatory check to exclude this possibility. I explained that grinding noises are more likely mechanical, such as faulty circulation or drain pumps. Without any verification, he proceeded to replace the heat pump and took off once it was replaced. Despite expressing concerns about potentially unresolved issues and urging him to stay another 10 minutes to allow confirmation, he left. A review of security footage showed he was on-site for approximately 40 minutes. I would have thought at least an hour be allocated for a full and thorough investigation, and the issue should be properly assessed and resolved before moving to another job. Furthermore, I did raise my concerns about potential mechanical issues warranting the need to replace either the circulation pump or drain pump under 'additional notes' when I requested a technician visit. Barely 10 minutes after he had left, the subsequent increment in noise level to 62dB, along with persistent loud grinding sound, clearly indicates a mechanical failure. I immediately called Bosch but was reprimanded for having 'unrealistic expectations' for the noise level. When I realized the technician had left something behind, I updated him on the issue but was advised to call Bosch and schedule another technician visit as he is moving on to other jobs. I have reviewed the technician's report. Whilst I fully acknowledge and agree that an intensive cycle is undeniably louder than other cycles, I find it hard to justify that the discrepancy is found to increase from 44dB to 62dB on a quiet cycle vs. an intensive cycle. One would expect 50dB for an intensive cycle to be more reasonable, especially when the machine is advertised as a 'Silence Plus' model. Furthermore, I found the technicians' behaviour and approach to the issue to be highly unsatisfactory. Instead of thoroughly investigating the problem and ensuring a proper resolution, they seemed more concerned with deflecting blame and adhering to questionable KPIs. Blaming the customer for perceived faults before considering manufacturing or mechanical issues is unacceptable and reflects poorly on Bosch's commitment to customer satisfaction. I have contacted the retailer for a refund and will escalate to the Office of Fair Trading after 2 weeks if this remains unresolved.

Sentence (English): This is a replacement for our 14 year old Bosch dishwasher which was great.
Comments (English): [ New Bosch 500 Series Dishwasher ] || ---------------- || This is a replacement for our 14 year old Bosch dishwasher which was great. The 500 series is very quiet and does a good job of cleaning dishes. The air dry feature does a good job--nice feature. My main complaint is that the 500 series has just one small silverware basket that goes on the side of the lower rack as opposed to a double basket on the older model. I realize that the 3rd rack is probably supposed to take the place of the 2nd lower basket, but it's not the same. In a basket, you can more easily drop silverware in without having to sort it which is much quicker and easier for daily use. We are going to order another side basket. Based on reviews, it appears that many share our opinion. Second and less of an issue. The middle rack does not roll in and out as smoothly as our old dishwasher--feels a bit flimsy.

Sentence (English): Dishwasher started to leak in the right front corner after 3 years.
Comments (English): [ Do NOT Buy - Leaks after 3 years - not covered ] || ---------------- || Dishwasher started to leak in the right front corner after 3 years. Hired a service guy to check and got the conclusion that the dishwasher was not properly installed which caused the front panel to bent over years. We thought the extended warranty from Citi Visa card would cover it as it was out of the 2-year warranty from Costco. However, Citi denied our service due to installation issue. Citi claimed installation issue is not covered by factory warranty neither. So I went back to talk to Costco as the installation was through Costco logistics. Costco then had someone to come over to my home to check on the machine. The guy from the logistics company concluded that it was the issue with the dishwasher, not the installation. He promised that he would enter all information to Costco and Costco will get back to me. That never happened. Since the dishwasher started to leak 3 months ago, we are still waiting for Costco to either replace the machine for us or share a letter from the logistics company stating that it is a machine issue so that I can claim extended warranty through Citi Visa card. I had tens of calls with Costco customer service and nobody seems really care about their customer in this situation. Using the Citi Anywhere Visa card to purchase appliances with Costco won't guarantee you the extended warranty as advertised - you can easily get stuck in-between Costco and Citi card and nobody will help you.

We have not tested tough, baked on foods yet.The bad - The integrated handle feels very cheap and we should have gone with the external bar handle. All of the racks also feel very cheap and rickety. They do not slide out smoothly at all and I noticed this with the display models as well. The handle for the middle rack is also silly being on the bottom of it instead of the top. I would have to really lean over to use it. There is absolutely nothing visible on the machine while it's running to tell you how long a cycle has left, since the digital display is on the top, underneath the counter and hidden. We had hoped there would be enough of a gap to be able to see between the counter and the top buttons, but there is not. The very top-most rack is something we have to get used to, but it barely fits all of our regular utensils. The tray looks huge, but once you actually put your silverware in, we ended up not being able to use both sides as the utensils extend more than half-way into the middle, preventing use by the other side (normal Oneida silverware, nothing crazy big). We do still have to use the half-utensil container for the bottom rack. Having to connect to the machine through an app just to run a delay cycle or set preferences is the most ridiculous thing we've encountered. We knew it was a feature going in, but after using it, it is just obnoxious.

It's nice that delivery, set up, and haul away are all included in price, and they provide items like additional hoses. The issue is Costco's delivery system. I ordered my dishwasher assuming that the day advertised in the Costco website would be the day I'd get delivery and set up. That turnaround would have been less than a week. Frustrating when you're dealing with a dead dishwasher and thought you'd have your new one fast. Costco needs to work on merging their scheduling platform with the 3rd party who actually installs and clearer communication to us as customers and letting the 3rd party installers know to have better communication with us when they takeover. It's confusing, and it was shared that there are constant complaints about this. The negative reviews end up falling to the installer, which is unfair to them too. Overall, the price can't be beat, but maybe it would be worth it to spend more to not deal with that stress.

We are not tough on a dishwasher--only use it a few times a week, rinse the dishes before placing them in the washer, don't have kids hitting buttons or slamming the dishwasher door. My previous Whirlpool dishwasher lasted 36 years. I love the look of this KitchenAid washer, the 3rd rack, the "Sani Rinse" feature, the layout of the racks; but, if it cannot function properly, all that means nothing. Now awaiting delivery of a Miele dishwasher.

Sentence (English): We had a Bosch in our prior home and loved it and we did our research on the new 500 model.
Comments (English): [ Great fit, look and cleans really well. ] || ---------------- || We had a Bosch in our prior home and loved it and we did our research on the new 500 model. Very high rating with CR. Looks great, fits really well, very quiet and seems to be cleaning very well. Price was competitive and delivery was a lot cheaper than a locally owned appliance retailer 1/4 mile from our home. I wanted to buy locally but I can't justify $120 more for just delivery. Easy to schedule delivery and delivery was on time. We did the removal of the old GE dishwasher that was in this home before we moved in. We also did the install. The first time we have attempted a dishwasher install. After watching numerous Bosch 500 install videos on YouTube we felt confident. The installation instructions have QR code links to detailed videos for each of the steps. Pretty cool. We took our time and had to increase the hole size to fit the plug through to the outlet. Our installation was a plug-in and the dishwasher came with the proper plug and interface for the connection to the dishwasher. Best Buy also included free of charge the interface and power box for a hardwired connection. Getting the dishwasher to the right height and level took some time. Don't bother attempting to use a screw driver to turn the feet, it's too much trouble. Tilt the unit back a little, lower the feet enough to expose the nut and use a 3/4\" wrench to adjust. We have granite countertops so we used the brackets on the side to secure the unit to the cabinets. The brackets for the kick plate took some time and effort to fit into the slot. I did set up the wireless Home Connect app but I'm not sure I would ever use it. Very happy with the product and the entire process.

If I hadn't spent many hours installing it, I would be sending it back.

Sentence (English): We purchased this dishwasher from out local Lowe's and it was delivered on 2/28/24.
Comments (English): We purchased this dishwasher from out local Lowe's and it was delivered on 2/28/24. I wanted to wait a bit before I wrote a review to actually see how it performed. First off, the delivery and installation was awesome, unlike what we experienced when Lowe's delivered our newest washing machine (replacing one that failed in less than 18 months). So kudos to the 3rd party plumber Lowe's used for the dishwasher delivery/installation. 5 stars for that.As far as the dishwasher, I have to admit to being pleasantly surprised. I tend to expect problems based on the personal experiences we've experienced in the recent past with new appliances. However, after almost two months of use, this dishwasher performs well. And that includes the drying cycle. It is not absolutely silent, but is quieter than the 5 year old model it replaced. My husband and I initially didn't think we'd like the upper silverware rack, but we love it…though there is a certain way to place the utensils so they don't fall over. I do rinse off everything before placing in the dishwasher, and I keep an eye of the rinse agent to ensure it's never empty…as the rinse agent is why things are able to dry completely.I did not give a 5 star review because the longevity is unknown. Nothing seems to be built as well as older models — and everything seems to have shorter and shorter lifespans. I hesitate to buy any new appliance now because of the overwhelming negative reviews across the board — regardless of brand, type of appliance, or price range. But for now, I am very happy with this particular purchase.

Sentence (English): For a long time, washing dishes by hand was a big burden for me.
Comments (English): [ Finally, no more hand washing dishes ] || ---------------- || For a long time, washing dishes by hand was a big burden for me. After 8 hours of work, shopping, cooking, I had no strength or desire to wash them. I decided that this could not go on any longer and a dishwasher had to appear in my apartment. Looking through various materials, I determined what my future dishwasher must have - first of all, Zeolith, thanks to which I would avoid choosing between wet dishes in a classic dishwasher and swollen furniture board and peeling veneer when the door opens automatically. Motivated by my parents' good opinion of the Bosch dishwasher, which has been in trouble-free service for 10 years, I knew that I had to have a Bosch as well. I chose the 6 series. I was sure that I had made the right choice after taking out the first batch of washed dishes. The dishwasher is practically silent, the washing effects are great, there is no question of problems with washing. The dishwasher has a Zeolith system - washed dishes are dry as soon as they are unloaded. Today I can't imagine life without a dishwasher.
Comments (Original): [ Nareszcie koniec ręcznego mycia naczyń ] || ---------------- || Od dłuższego czasu mocno ciążyło mi ręczne zmywanie naczyń. Po 8 godzinach pracy, zakupach, gotowaniu na zmywanie nie było już sił, ani tym bardziej chęci. Zdecydowałem, że tak dłużej być nie może i w moim mieszkaniu musi pojawić się zmywarka. Przeglądając różnego rodzaju materiały określiłem co moja przyszła zmywarka musi posiadać - przede wszystkim Zeolith, dzięki któremu uniknę wyboru między mokrymi naczyniami w klasycznej zmywarce, a napuchniętą płytą meblową i odchodzącą okleiną przy automatycznym otwieraniu drzwi. Zmotywowany dobrą opinią rodziców o zmywarce Bosch, służącej bezawaryjnie już 10 lat, wiedziałem, że u mnie również musi stanąć Bosch. Wybór padł na serię 6. O trafności wyboru upewniłem się po wyjęciu pierwszej partii umytych naczyń. Zmywarka jest właściwie niesłyszalna, efekty mycia są świetne, nie ma mowy o problemach z domywaniem. Zmywarka posiada system Zeolith - umyte naczynia są suche już w momencie rozładunku. Dzisiaj nie wyobrażam sobie już życia bez zmywarki.

He explained that it would be better to open it towards the sink because you have to put it in with the larva. So I installed it so that the door opens towards the sink. As an additional explanation, people who are installing it for the first time usually install it so that it opens towards the front, and people who have used it install it so that it opens towards the sink. Anyway, I think it was a good idea to install it so that the door opens towards the sink. As an additional explanation, he said to remove food without detergent and put it in with a sponge, but I always thought, why put a dishwasher in if you're going to put the larva in? That's because I thought you have to use dishwashing detergent on the larva itself. If you just clean it with a sponge without detergent, then whatever. I thought it was okay to just do it. And at first, I was curious about what would happen if I didn't listen and turned it on without the larva, so I just put the pot in, but the stains that had built up wouldn't come off. I think I need to scrub it with a dishwashing sponge to get rid of the stuck-on dirt. All modes have a forced drying mode, so I turn off the drying mode and run it every time I run it. It costs a lot of electricity and takes a long time, so there's no reason to dry it quickly. It was a bit annoying when the pot wasn't cleaned, but whenever there are dishes to wash (I wash them right away), I gather them and run it, and it feels convenient. I want to use it for a long time without any problems ^^ Tip: If you're buying this product and looking for a dishwasher detergent in advance, take a look. I bought liquid detergent, but according to the pamphlet you gave me, the Bespoke dishwasher is specifically for solid detergents. The second time I used the liquid detergent, it stopped with a full bubble error because I didn't use the special detergent. So I bought a very famous solid detergent and am using it, and the cleaning power is better and it works well without errors.

Sentence (English): I had a dish dryer before, so I was worried, but this time, I bought a dishwasher from my aunt because it is a good value for money product from Samsung.
Comments (English): I had a dish dryer before, so I was worried, but this time, I bought a dishwasher from my aunt because it is a good value for money product from Samsung. Product color: It said white, but it is not white. Anyway, it is gray. Product design: Simple square shape, and the front is tempered glass, so it is very simple and luxurious. Service installation: Two Samsung technicians came and installed it very kindly. I am very satisfied. Function: I haven't done it yet, but the technician ran it for a while and it was in very good condition. I will try it soon after I wash the dishes. It seems to be very good for washing dishes because it is spacious for 12 people, but there are comments that say that the 12-person dishwasher is good when there is a lot of food, but it is sometimes difficult to run when there is a small amount of food, and it seems inconvenient when moving, but this product is not burdensome in terms of price and can wash small amounts, so I am satisfied. (For reference, there are 4 people in the family.) Conclusion: It is stressful when the amount of dishes piles up when you are busy. There are many people who say that bringing in a dishwasher auntie is a new world, so I brought it in this time, and I hope that thanks to her, I can relieve my stress. ~ After 2 weeks of use, sound: Some people say that the sound of the dishwasher is loud, but you can think of it as the sound of a washing machine. The noise of the dishwasher when it drains water is almost as loud as a washing machine. In the case of a washing machine, I put it in the laundry room and close the door so that I don't hear the sound of the washing machine, but since I put the dishwasher in the kitchen and use it, I have to accept the noise with my whole ears. When I turn the dishes upside down or stand them up like plates, and when I wash spoons and chopsticks, they are not washed perfectly, and water accumulates, so I take them out again and wash them and dry them in the dryer. Overall: I brought in a dishwasher auntie for convenience, but she is a bit slow at washing dishes, and she doesn't wash the dishes perfectly, so I have to do some work. ~ I guess I'll have to use it with regret until a dishwasher that improves the shortcomings (sound, perfect washing, washing time) comes out. ~

Service installation: Two Samsung technicians came and installed it very kindly. I am very satisfied. Function: I haven't done it yet, but the technician ran it for a while and it was in very good condition. I will try it soon after I wash the dishes. It seems to be very good for washing dishes because it is spacious for 12 people, but there are comments that say that the 12-person dishwasher is good when there is a lot of food, but it is sometimes difficult to run when there is a small amount of food, and it seems inconvenient when moving, but this product is not burdensome in terms of price and can wash small amounts, so I am satisfied. (For reference, there are 4 people in the family.) Conclusion: It is stressful when the amount of dishes piles up when you are busy. There are many people who say that bringing in a dishwasher auntie is a new world, so I brought it in this time, and I hope that thanks to her, I can relieve my stress. ~ After 2 weeks of use, sound: Some people say that the sound of the dishwasher is loud, but you can think of it as the sound of a washing machine. The noise of the dishwasher when it drains water is almost as loud as a washing machine. In the case of a washing machine, I put it in the laundry room and close the door so that I don't hear the sound of the washing machine, but since I put the dishwasher in the kitchen and use it, I have to accept the noise with my whole ears. When I turn the dishes upside down or stand them up like plates, and when I wash spoons and chopsticks, they are not washed perfectly, and water accumulates, so I take them out again and wash them and dry them in the dryer. Overall: I brought in a dishwasher auntie for convenience, but she is a bit slow at washing dishes, and she doesn't wash the dishes perfectly, so I have to do some work. ~ I guess I'll have to use it with regret until a dishwasher that improves the shortcomings (sound, perfect washing, washing time) comes out. ~
Comments (Original): 기존에 식기건조기가 있어서 고심고심하다가 이번에 삼성 가성비 좋은 제품이라 이번에 식기세척기 이모님 모셔왔습니다.  제품색 : 화이트라고 했는데 화이트는 아니구요. 여튼 회색빛입니다. 제품디자인 : 심플한 사각형 정사각형의 모양  앞면은 강화유리 처리로 매우 심플하고 고급스럽습니다.  서비스 설치 : 두 분의 삼성기사분이 오셔서 아주매우 친절하게 설치해주셨습니다. 매우 만족입니다.  기능 : 아직 진행은 안해보았으나, 기사분이 잠깐 운행해 주셨는데 매우 좋은 상태로 진행되었습니다. 설겆이감을 빨리 쌓아서 해보아야겠습니다. 12인이 넓어서 식기세척하기는 매우 좋을 듯 하나,  식기세척기 12인은 양이 많을 때는 좋기는 하지만 양이 적을 때 돌리기는 그럴 때가 있다고 하는 댓글이 있고  이사시에 불편할 것 같기도 하고  이 제품은 가격부분 이나 적은 양도 부담스럽지 않게 세척할 수 있어서 만족합니다.(참고로 가족 4인입니다.)  결론 : 바쁠 때 설겆이 양이 쌓일 때 스트레스가 되더라구요.  식기세척기 이모님 모셔오면 너무 너무 신세계라는 분들이 많아서  이번에 들여놓았는데 이모님 덕분에 스트레스에서 벗어날 수 있기를 바래보아요. ~ ㅎ  2주일 사용 후  소리 : 세척기 돌아가는 소리가 크다고 하시는 분들도 있는데 세탁기 소리 정도 난다 생각하시면 됩니다. 식기세척기 물 배출시 거의 세탁기 수준의 소음입니다. 세탁기의 경우는 세탁실에 넣어두고 문을 닫아 세탁기 돌아가는 소리가 들리지 않지만 식기세척기는 주방쪽에 놓고 사용하는 것이라 소음을 온 귀로 받아들여야 합니다. 그릇을 뒤집어 놓거나 접시처럼 세워 놓는 경우, 그리고 숟가락 젖가락은 잘 닦이나, 그릇이 겹쳐지는 경우는 세척도 완벽하게 되지 않고 물이 고여있거나 하기에 다시 한번 꺼내 씻고 건조기에 말립니다. 총평 : 편하려고 식기세척기 이모님 모셔왔는데 설겆이 시간이 좀 느린 편이시고, 완벽하게 식기를 세척해 주시지 않아 손이 좀 가는 편입니다. ~ 단점들(소리, 완벽한 세척, 세척시간)을 보완한 식기세척기가 나올 때까지 아쉬운대로 사용해야 겠네요. ~

Product color: It said white, but it is not white. Anyway, it is gray. Product design: Simple square shape, and the front is tempered glass, so it is very simple and luxurious. Service installation: Two Samsung technicians came and installed it very kindly. I am very satisfied. Function: I haven't done it yet, but the technician ran it for a while and it was in very good condition. I will try it soon after I wash the dishes. It seems to be very good for washing dishes because it is spacious for 12 people, but there are comments that say that the 12-person dishwasher is good when there is a lot of food, but it is sometimes difficult to run when there is a small amount of food, and it seems inconvenient when moving, but this product is not burdensome in terms of price and can wash small amounts, so I am satisfied. (For reference, there are 4 people in the family.) Conclusion: It is stressful when the amount of dishes piles up when you are busy. There are many people who say that bringing in a dishwasher auntie is a new world, so I brought it in this time, and I hope that thanks to her, I can relieve my stress. ~ After 2 weeks of use, sound: Some people say that the sound of the dishwasher is loud, but you can think of it as the sound of a washing machine. The noise of the dishwasher when it drains water is almost as loud as a washing machine. In the case of a washing machine, I put it in the laundry room and close the door so that I don't hear the sound of the washing machine, but since I put the dishwasher in the kitchen and use it, I have to accept the noise with my whole ears. When I turn the dishes upside down or stand them up like plates, and when I wash spoons and chopsticks, they are not washed perfectly, and water accumulates, so I take them out again and wash them and dry them in the dryer. Overall: I brought in a dishwasher auntie for convenience, but she is a bit slow at washing dishes, and she doesn't wash the dishes perfectly, so I have to do some work. ~ I guess I'll have to use it with regret until a dishwasher that improves the shortcomings (sound, perfect washing, washing time) comes out. ~
Comments (Original): 기존에 식기건조기가 있어서 고심고심하다가 이번에 삼성 가성비 좋은 제품이라 이번에 식기세척기 이모님 모셔왔습니다.  제품색 : 화이트라고 했는데 화이트는 아니구요. 여튼 회색빛입니다. 제품디자인 : 심플한 사각형 정사각형의 모양  앞면은 강화유리 처리로 매우 심플하고 고급스럽습니다.  서비스 설치 : 두 분의 삼성기사분이 오셔서 아주매우 친절하게 설치해주셨습니다. 매우 만족입니다.  기능 : 아직 진행은 안해보았으나, 기사분이 잠깐 운행해 주셨는데 매우 좋은 상태로 진행되었습니다. 설겆이감을 빨리 쌓아서 해보아야겠습니다. 12인이 넓어서 식기세척하기는 매우 좋을 듯 하나,  식기세척기 12인은 양이 많을 때는 좋기는 하지만 양이 적을 때 돌리기는 그럴 때가 있다고 하는 댓글이 있고  이사시에 불편할 것 같기도 하고  이 제품은 가격부분 이나 적은 양도 부담스럽지 않게 세척할 수 있어서 만족합니다.(참고로 가족 4인입니다.)  결론 : 바쁠 때 설겆이 양이 쌓일 때 스트레스가 되더라구요.  식기세척기 이모님 모셔오면 너무 너무 신세계라는 분들이 많아서  이번에 들여놓았는데 이모님 덕분에 스트레스에서 벗어날 수 있기를 바래보아요. ~ ㅎ  2주일 사용 후  소리 : 세척기 돌아가는 소리가 크다고 하시는 분들도 있는데 세탁기 소리 정도 난다 생각하시면 됩니다. 식기세척기 물 배출시 거의 세탁기 수준의 소음입니다. 세탁기의 경우는 세탁실에 넣어두고 문을 닫아 세탁기 돌아가는 소리가 들리지 않지만 식기세척기는 주방쪽에 놓고 사용하는 것이라 소음을 온 귀로 받아들여야 합니다. 그릇을 뒤집어 놓거나 접시처럼 세워 놓는 경우, 그리고 숟가락 젖가락은 잘 닦이나, 그릇이 겹쳐지는 경우는 세척도 완벽하게 되지 않고 물이 고여있거나 하기에 다시 한번 꺼내 씻고 건조기에 말립니다. 총평 : 편하려고 식기세척기 이모님 모셔왔는데 설겆이 시간이 좀 느린 편이시고, 완벽하게 식기를 세척해 주시지 않아 손이 좀 가는 편입니다. ~ 단점들(소리, 완벽한 세척, 세척시간)을 보완한 식기세척기가 나올 때까지 아쉬운대로 사용해야 겠네요. ~

Sentence (English): The 6-person dishwasher I had been using for 14 years was malfunctioning often, so I held on for a year before purchasing it.
Comments (English): [ It was a good idea to buy a dishwasher at this event. ] || ---------------- || The 6-person dishwasher I had been using for 14 years was malfunctioning often, so I held on for a year before purchasing it. I saw that another model was on sale for a special price, so I looked to see what it was, and that evening, there was news of a special price on live broadcast, so I looked further. They sell all sorts of things! hot air dry! Single dry sterilization! I'm selling a dishwasher with functions! There is also an additional discount from credit card companies and 12-month installment plans! That amount is worth it! So, I ordered it with a happy heart. I was told the delivery time could be long, so I thought it would take about 15 days, but it arrived in almost 3 days and the installation was completed. The technician called me the day before to confirm the installation location and guided me through the installation and cost of the stand to separate the induction cooker and dishwasher I was using. . It was nice to be able to prepare in advance. I removed the light wave oven and cabinet that had been there since I moved in and installed it in its place, so it looked incredibly clean and the colors matched well. I bought it just for the functionality and price, but oh my! It was complicated because the food dehydrator, water saver, water purifier, existing dishwasher boiler controller, etc. were all connected to the lower cabinet of the sink, but the work was carried out skillfully. The technician also took care of the removal and collection of the existing dishwasher and moved the location of the light wave oven. When I purchased from Gmarket, I was very worried because, unlike products from other companies, there was no information about the process. I was nervous because I thought I would have to call someone to remove the lower cabinet in advance or pay an additional fee, but I was really thankful that I didn't. The induction stand was also paid for by credit card. I have to learn how to use and maintain the new dishwasher one by one, but I am very proud because I feel like I have definitely achieved something.

I saw that another model was on sale for a special price, so I looked to see what it was, and that evening, there was news of a special price on live broadcast, so I looked further. They sell all sorts of things! hot air dry! Single dry sterilization! I'm selling a dishwasher with functions! There is also an additional discount from credit card companies and 12-month installment plans! That amount is worth it! So, I ordered it with a happy heart. I was told the delivery time could be long, so I thought it would take about 15 days, but it arrived in almost 3 days and the installation was completed. The technician called me the day before to confirm the installation location and guided me through the installation and cost of the stand to separate the induction cooker and dishwasher I was using. . It was nice to be able to prepare in advance. I removed the light wave oven and cabinet that had been there since I moved in and installed it in its place, so it looked incredibly clean and the colors matched well. I bought it just for the functionality and price, but oh my! Comments (English): [ Quiet, but slow, & doesn't dry well ] || ---------------- || Quiet, but slow, & doesn't dry well. This product isn't bad, don't get me wrong. It just doesn't have the most powerful drying cycle. It also takes 3-4 hours on a "normal" cycle, so plan your cycles according. Also, using the "steam/sanitize" function seems to make your dishes even more wet during the drying cycle. So small tip. make sure that function is disabled if you hope to have your dishes even remotely dry at the end of the wash. The 3rd rack is very handy, and it's very spacious for being the standard size washer (24"). Just be careful pulling out the 2 top racks, or you'll risk getting things on the bottom rack soaked (if they aren't already). I would have given this a 3 and a half, but Lowe's didn't allow that as an option. All-in-all, it's a solid machine. I could even live with the long cycle if it just dried the dishes better. Comments (English): [ Love my new Kitchenaid dishwasher! ] || ---------------- || It's only been a week, but so far I love my new Kitchenaid dishwasher! My prior dishwasher, a Kitchenaid, lasted 16 years and was used at least twice per week, so not only did I feel happy with the long life span, I was familiar with the operation of the product. I do love the addition of the third rack, the adjustable height of the middle rack, and the quiet operation of the new dishwasher. I also like the light feature on the door, showing the stages of the wash cycle. I am also a big fan of the stainless interior. I rinse dishes before loading them into the dishwasher, but I do not pre-wash. I have been very happy with the cleanliness of my dishes. Overall, I am very pleased with my new purchase and am exploring the option of adding a new Kitchenaid double-oven range and French-door refrigerator.

Comments (English): [ Storage for Hoses are a Problem ] || ---------------- || The dishwasher itself works great. The problem is the intake hose that connects to the faucet. The way the hoses are stored in the back of the dishwasher is a bit of a free-for-all (I think it's just an empty space back there behind the metal exterior), so the rubber from the hoses tend to twist, kink, and get caught on the edges of the plastic panel that holds them in place. This results in the rubber exterior of the hose becoming torn and frayed. It's obvious that very little thought has been put into this particular part of the dishwasher, and there isn't anything we can do to remedy the situation. So while we have to wrestle with the hoses to both store them and deploy them, residual water from hoses gets strewn all over our kitchen floor. So the clean up every time we use the dishwasher is pretty annoying. I'm crossing my fingers that we won't have to replace the whole unit or take it apart to replace the hoses if they crack or leak.

Sentence (English): First time buying a Bosch dishwasher after having 5 (other brand, not Bosch) dishwashers over 27 years that just gave out.
Comments (English): [ First time Bosch buyer. ] || ---------------- || First time buying a Bosch dishwasher after having 5 (other brand, not Bosch) dishwashers over 27 years that just gave out. Also first time buying a kitchen appliance from Best Buy. Very happy so far. It had great reviews and everyone I spoke with told me to get a Bosch. Very happy so far with it. It is extremely quiet and has a quick 60 minute wash cycle. The only thing I wish it had was a message or light indicating the cycle was done and the dishes were clean. The timer goes to zero and then all lights turn off, so, we have to put notes on the counter when it is clean/dirty. If the lights stayed on indicating it was done until the dishwasher door was opened, this dishwasher would have been perfect. Very happy with the dishwasher so far. It cleans very well and is extremely quiet! There is a top rack for flatware and a basket for flatware on the bottom rack. It has taken a little time to figure out how to load the dishwasher for maximum efficiency. The middle/top rack is adjustable and very easy to adjust to accommodate larger glasses or items on the top. There is no heating element to dry the dishes, it is just air, so, jet dry finish liquid must be added to have the washer. The dishes always come out dry and plastic can be placed on the bottom rack without being warped. I was very surprised how dry the dishes are when the cycle is over. The door closes and opens easily. Sentence (English): Bought this to replace a 5 year old GE that died.
Comments (English): [ Not a Gimmick, PowerControl Spray Arm is Awesome ] || ---------------- || Bought this to replace a 5 year old GE that died. My old washer was ok, but it is very noticeable how much better the Bosch 800 is. First it is very quiet, can barely hear it running standing next to it. The dishes come out are very clean, the racking options are nice as I am able to fit a wide variety of dishware all at one. The power control spray arm is not a gimmick and is very useful. It is nice being able to put heavily soiled pots and pans in one or more of the 4 zone, dishes in any other zone, and customize each of the 4 zones to more aggressively wash the bakeware but be gentle on regular dishes all in the same load. Also since there is no exposed heating element on the bottom, dishwasher safe plastics can go on any rack without getting melted. The crystal dry I would say works very well but is not perfect. My only concern is the door latch, I am not sure how long that will hold up over time, but since it is a latch hopefully it is simple replacement if needed in the future. Overall had this dishwasher for about 2 months and very pleased with its performance. It seems like I can load more dishes, including a wider variety of pans and bakeware, into a single cycle than my old dishwasher and everything comes out very clean.

Sentence (English): I purchased this dishwasher in December 2021 and installed it in February 2022.
Comments (English): [ Worst purchase ever! DON'T Waste your Money! ] || ---------------- || I purchased this dishwasher in December 2021 and installed it in February 2022. All of my major appliances are Samsung! TVs (5), refrigerator, stove, oven, microwave, washer and dryer, and 5 Samsung Galaxy cell phones. It pains me to write this negative review because I love everything Samsung! First, the good—the dishwasher Looks Great, is Extremely Quiet, has 3 racks, and has nice features. Luckily, as others have reported, mine has never leaked. The bad - I had to have it serviced 3 times in the first 3 months. Control Panel (aka motherboard) kept failing. Samsung repair finally replaced the control panel. It worked for about 3 months, and then the Linear Wash Bar stopped moving. We replaced the magnet, and the linear wash bar worked for about a week. I ordered and replaced the magnet again, worked for another week to 2 weeks, then stopped moving again. The linear bar is stuck in the forward position (closest to the door). The Linear bar will no longer move, even with replacing the magnet for a 3rd time. The bottom rack will not clean dishes no matter what setting I try! The top rack upper sprayer arm that spins to wash the utensils broke an fell off after owning the dishwasher 8 months. We replaced it, and it is still working. The middle rack spray arm broke, falling off, so we replaced it. Stayed connected for about a month. However, the middle sprayer will not stay on and fall off every load. It sometimes falls off during the cycle, but more often, when pulling out the middle rack, the enter wash arms disconnect and fall off. We have to reconnect the middle wash arm nearly every cycle. The only dishes that get somewhat clean are the middle and top racks, but that's only when the wash arms stay connected and don't fall off mid-cycle. I was getting ready to schedule another repair through Samsung when I changed my mind. I'm now researching and shopping for new dishwashers from other brands. I have no faith in Samsung repairing this machine, as it is the most unreliable appliance I have ever owned. Samsung's Quality Control is irreprehensible; even if repaired for the 10th time, it will undoubtedly break again! Save your money by buying a different brand of dishwasher. DO NOT buy this dishwasher! It is a complete waste of time and money!

Sentence (English): <2-Month Review>.
Comments (English): [ A must-have for husbands these days! ] || ---------------- || <2-Month Review>. It's been a little over two months since I started using it. Now that I've gotten used to the dish Tetris game, I'm experiencing a whole new world. It might only take a few minutes a day, but not having to do the dishes by hand gives me so much free time, which is great. I only use it once every two or three days. It takes about three minutes to load the dishes and run them. It's already been about a month since I started using it. I was planning on leaving a review right after purchasing it, but I'm finally writing this now to be more honest and truthful. At first, I had trouble getting used to the dish Tetris game, but I'm finally getting used to it. I was hesitant for about two years because of the price, but when the price dropped a bit, I took the plunge and bought this dishwasher! To be honest, I regret buying it so late. People who haven't used a dishwasher before often say, "If you're going to do that, why spend so much money on a dishwasher instead of just handwashing?" But after using it for about a month, I realized that's just nonsense. I figured it out ^^. My hands still get wet, but it significantly reduces dishwashing time and is incredibly convenient. I feel like I have more freedom in my life, you could say? Reasons for purchase: - I hate wasting time washing dishes every day. - Prices have dropped a lot compared to before. - I work all day and am so tired of washing dishes after work. - I hate the rough feeling on my hands, similar to eczema. Before purchasing the dishwasher, I washed dishes every day. Now, I just collect the dishes and do it every other day. It saves time, reduces fatigue, and is so convenient. It's so convenient that I regret buying it too late. Functionality: - It really cleans better than washing dishes by hand. - It has high-temperature washing, steam, and hot air drying, so I can trust its cleanliness. - It's not loud, but it's not annoying at all, although it may vary depending on the individual. (See video) - As you can see in the photo, the detergent dispenser has been improved and is now conveniently located near the lower drying rack (see photo). Sink cabinet construction. - My sink is narrow, so the dishwasher takes up 1.5 shelves. On the day of delivery, the delivery person neatly finished the sink installation, so no additional work was needed.
